rows.criteria: Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility for their projects from approval through to issue, following up open items without being chased
Following Company Standards - Consistently applies the Austruss naming, revision, filing and drafting standards without reminders
Communication & Record Keeping - Keeps clients, engineers and the team informed, with emails, RFIs and decisions kept in the right thread and place
Openness to Review & Feedback - Welcomes peer review, acts on comments promptly and does not repeat the same mistakes
Thoroughness - Checks their own work against the latest architectural and engineering information before passing it on or issuing it
Teamwork & Support - Gives thorough peer reviews to others, shares knowledge and helps keep projects moving when someone is away
